candidate.change: Replace the separate moe_route_accumulate output write plus next-layer add_inplace with one moe_route_accumulate_add dispatch that preserves x residual and adds weighted routed/shared expert output in place.
candidate.mechanism: The MoE output is consumed only by the next layer's residual add (or final epilogue); the fused kernel computes the identical fp32 accumulation directly into x_buf. Routing, expert weights, KV, MLA, RoPE, tokenizer, and command-buffer ordering remain unchanged.
candidate.hypothesis: Removing one hidden-width memory pass and one dispatch per routed layer lowers complete-token wall time by at least 3 percent without changing the 32-token source continuation.

claim_boundary: One bounded same-model runtime experiment only; no TG, capability, CLEAN lease, production, or owner authorization claim.
